parsed.refutation_attempt: The reported sink is kill(getppid(), SIGINT) on line 32. kill() is a system call that sends a signal to a process; it does not execute an external command string. The source of the PID is getppid(), which returns the parent process ID of the current process and is an internal value, not influenced by any untrusted input. Therefore there is no path from untrusted data to a command execution primitive, and OS Command Injection cannot occur here.
